content.short: Paima Engine provides a framework for creating app-specific L2s for gaming and autonomous worlds.
content.description: Paima Engine empowers developers to build on-chain games using TypeScript, Unity, and Game Maker. Apps built with Paima deploy app-specific Layer 2s that are non-custodial, so user funds stay on their L1 account and aren’t at risk even if the game is shut down or hacked. By providing a framework tailored to gaming and autonomous worlds, Paima Engine helps teams ship on-chain experiences faster and with greater safety than alternative approaches.
content.meta: Paima Engine lets developers write on-chain games using Typescript, Unity, and Game Maker. Discover Paima Engine and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
